Top B2C ad platforms for 2026


Generated by Klaviyo AI


The article explains how digital advertising platforms support B2C brands with targeted, personalized campaigns across social, search, programmatic, and CTV. It outlines 11 key platforms and shows how integrating them with Klaviyo B2C CRM can improve targeting, ROAS, and cross-channel orchestration.


-


**Role of ad platforms:** Digital advertising platforms let B2C brands reach specific audiences with sponsored content in multiple formats, aligned to goals like awareness, engagement, lead generation, and sales.


-


**Goal-based bidding:** Marketers are advised to match bidding strategies to objectives—for example, optimizing for impressions for awareness, sign-ups for subscribers, engagement metrics for interaction, and conversions for sales.


-


**Eleven key channels:** The piece profiles 11 platforms—including TikTok, Google Ads, Meta, Pinterest, AdRoll, Vibe, StackAdapt, Pinpoint, Blend AI, Customers.ai, and X—and highlights their audiences, formats, and B2C use cases.


-


**Power of integrations:** Integrations with Klaviyo B2C CRM enable syncing segments, building lookalike and exclusion audiences, retargeting high-intent visitors, and measuring performance such as ROAS across channels.


-


**Improving ROAS:** By continuously refining creative, targeting, and audiences—and avoiding spend on recent purchasers—brands can reduce costs and drive higher returns from their digital ad investments.

---


Have you seen an ad recently where you thought, “How did they know I’ve been looking for this?”


Digital ads have gotten smarter and more personalized, thanks to better integrations with marketing systems and more advanced targeting options on digital advertising platforms.


Consumers today even like ads they see while they’re scrolling through TikTok or Instagram, precisely because they’re relevant. When you approach them right, ads help people find products they’ve been looking for or solve a problem they’ve been stuck on.[Kantar’s Media Reactions 2025 report](https://www.kantar.com/campaigns/media-reactions) found that more than half of consumers (57%) have positive feelings about ads.


For B2C brands, digital ads are part of a personalized omnichannel marketing strategy that reaches customers across all the channels where they engage, with meaningful content, when they’re most active.[WPP Media reports](https://www.wppmedia.com/news/report-this-year-next-year-december-2025) that advertising spend reached an estimated $1.14 trillion in 2025, and they predict that global advertising revenue will grow 7% in 2026.


With growing approval from consumers and massive investments from brands, B2C marketers need to make sure they’re using the best digital advertising platforms to get the best possible return on ad spend (ROAS).


## What are digital advertising platforms?


Digital advertising platforms allow you to target specific audiences with sponsored ads in formats like images, videos, carousels, and stories. Many platforms have bid-based payment structures using cost per impression, cost per engagement, or cost per conversion.


By connecting your[B2C CRM](https://www.klaviyo.com/platform) with your digital advertising platform, you can target your existing audience with ads, find new audiences that match the characteristics of your customers, and use customer data to personalize ads.


## How do digital advertising platforms help marketers reach their goals?


When using a digital advertising platform, your goals should align with your bidding strategy.


Here are some of the most common goals marketers have for digital ads, and the recommended bidding strategy for each:


- **Increasing brand awareness:** Optimize for impressions and reach.
- **Bringing in new subscribers:** Optimize for sign-ups.
- **Driving engagement:** Optimize for messages, video views, likes, comments or saves.
- **Generating sales:** Optimize for conversions on your website.


After launching your ads, it’s best practice to continuously update your creative, targeting parameters, and audiences. This helps reduce your costs and improve performance, driving up your ROAS.


## 11 of the best digital advertising platforms for engaging a B2C audience


As a B2C brand, you want to show up where your audience is active to make the most of your advertising budget. Here are 11 digital advertising platforms that can help you efficiently reach new and existing customers:


### TikTok for Business


According to a[Kepios data analysis](https://datareportal.com/social-media-users) , brands can reach almost 2 billion people on TikTok.[TikTok ads](https://ads.tiktok.com/business/en-US) help brands build their TikTok community, find new customers, and convert visitors into buyers. These ads are specifically relevant for CPG and retail brands, and good for brands at any budget since you can only pay for the actions that you want.


TikTok commissioned[research with Nielsen](https://ads.tiktok.com/business/en-CA/blog/tiktok-works-ads-drive-business-impact?redirected=1) to understand the impact of TikTok ads and found a 96% higher paid media ROAS than other digital media channels, and 2.9x higher sales efficiency. At the time, TikTok was also the fastest-growing channel for discovering new brands.


If you already have established lists and segments in Klaviyo B2C CRM, you can sync these audiences into TikTok for Business using Klaviyo’s[TikTok Audiences integration](https://marketplace.klaviyo.com/en-us/apps/01hq8r57fcmy9xbda1dnmy8e7t/) to target them with ads, or find lookalike audiences that reflect your top customers.


And in the other direction, once you generate new subscribers via TikTok ads, you can use Klaviyo’s[TikTok Lead Ads integration](https://marketplace.klaviyo.com/en-us/apps/01j2a7e1pyttt7w0aftceh7v85/) to automatically sync them into the CRM in real time, where you can continue the conversation via email, text messages, WhatsApp messages, and more.


### Google Ads


You can choose between a few different types of[Google Ads](https://business.google.com/en-all/google-ads/) campaigns, including Performance Max Campaigns, search ads, display ads, shopping ads, video ads, and app ads across the Google ecosystem—Google Search, Google Suite, and YouTube. If you haven’t run ads using Google Ads before, they offer new advertisers ad credits to get started and see how they work out.


[WordStream](https://www.wordstream.com/blog/2024-google-ads-benchmarks) analyzed 17,000+ search ad campaigns and found that cost per click averages $4.66, while conversion rate averages 6.96%. Overall, ecommerce and retail brands tend to have lower costs per click, and services businesses have higher costs per click.


To bring Google Ads into your greater marketing strategy and help reduce the costs of your ads, you can use Klaviyo’s[Google Ads integration](http://marketplace.klaviyo.com/en-us/apps/01h3z8tn2z62yp05cynfhnpwk8/) to:


- Sync Klaviyo segments to Google Ads and target existing customers.
- Create integrated campaigns using Klaviyo data in Google Ads.
- Measure and improve ad performance using Klaviyo insights, like purchases, marketing engagement, or customer lifetime value.


Brand group[Helen of Troy](https://www.helenoftroy.com/our-brands/) uses Klaviyo’s Google Ads integration to[build lookalike audiences](https://www.klaviyo.com/customers/case-studies/helen-of-troy) to target, and they exclude current email and text message marketing subscribers from paid acquisition campaigns to focus on new customers. In an increasingly cookieless environment, the integration gives Helen of Troy more access to customer data for better paid media targeting.


### Meta for Business


With[Meta for Business](https://www.facebook.com/business/ads?ref=bmcg) , you can target audiences across Facebook ads, Instagram ads, and ads clicking to WhatsApp and Messenger—and these ads have the potential to reach billions of people. The Kepios data analysis shows an estimated audience of 2.35 billion on Facebook, 1.91 billion on Instagram, and 942 million on Messenger.


For reference,[WordStream finds](https://www.wordstream.com/resources/facebook-benchmarks?cid=Web_WS_InContent_Guide_FBAdsBenchmarks2024_Download) that for Facebook ads:


- The average click rate for traffic campaigns is 1.71%.
- The average cost per click for traffic campaigns is $0.70.
- The average click rate for leads campaigns is 2.59%.
- The average cost per click for leads campaigns is $1.92.
- The average conversion rate for leads campaigns is 7.72%.
- The average cost per lead is $27.66.


Meta ads are ideal for increasing sales, driving in-store traffic, and bringing in new customers more efficiently. With Klaviyo’s[Meta Ads integration](https://marketplace.klaviyo.com/en-us/apps/01h3z8tm3g2363v35y7jdk6dfr/) , you can:


- Reach audiences like recent browsers, unengaged customers, or cart abandoners with retargeting ads.
- Save money by avoiding overlap, and focus on customers who are predicted to be high-value or who have shopped with you in the past.
- Cross-sell to recent buyers with products you know they’ll love.
- Create lookalike audiences from lists of your best customers.


Men’s underwear brand[2(X)IST](https://2xist.com/) uses Klaviyo’s Meta Ads integration for smarter remarketing ad campaigns. Since their most loyal customers don’t need paid reminders to keep purchasing, they exclude loyalists and champions from paid campaigns using RFM segments. After restructuring their paid campaigns, their[ROAS increased 61% YoY](https://www.klaviyo.com/blog/klaviyo-facebook-integration-example-use-cases) .


### Pinterest Ads Manager


Pinterest has a growing audience of about 350 million, according to the Kepios data analysis.[Pinterest ads](https://ads.pinterest.com/) are sponsored posts that show up in users’ Pinterest feeds. They can be geared towards awareness, consideration, or conversion, helping you reach customers across their entire journey.


[According to Pinterest](https://business.pinterest.com/) , the No. 1 reason users are on the platform is to discover products and brands. That makes Pinterest a strong social media platform if you’re looking to bring in new customers or promote new products to existing audiences.


As part of your[Pinterest marketing strategy](https://www.klaviyo.com/blog/pinterest-marketing-strategies#target-audiences-that-are-already-interested-in-your-brand4) , ads are an efficient way to get in front of only the folks that are most likely to take action, rather than trying to get in front of everyone possible.


Using Klaviyo’s[Pinterest Audiences integration](https://marketplace.klaviyo.com/en-us/apps/01j01pqcsj65zb3t4q6p4segcd/) , you can bring Klaviyo audiences into Pinterest to target customers and subscribers, and build:


- Lookalike audiences that reflect the behaviors of your best customers
- Exclusionary audiences that suppress recently converted audiences from ads
- Engagement audiences of contacts who recently engaged but didn’t convert


### AdRoll


[AdRoll](https://www.adroll.com/) is an AI-powered connected advertising platform that helps businesses run multi-channel advertising campaigns across the whole marketing lifecycle.


To improve omnichannel marketing, Klaviyo’s[AdRoll integration](https://marketplace.klaviyo.com/en-us/apps/01hv9pxkhr9nhhvj0865jkq7xb/) lets you import Klaviyo lists and segments into the platform, then retarget audiences across the web, connected TV (CTV), and social sites like Meta, TikTok, and Pinterest.


By connecting Klaviyo with AdRoll, you can also access performance metrics like ROAS and click rates, so you can optimize campaigns and get more out of your ad budget.


### Vibe


[Vibe](https://www.vibe.co/) is an AI-powered platform for retargeting audiences with TV ads, called CTV campaigns. Vibe is geared towards ecommerce, retail, gaming, and entertainment brands, and others that want to generate awareness, drive sales, attract traffic, and retarget subscribers.


Today, CTV ads are accessible to companies of any size, unlike in the past when only large brands advertised on TV. Vibe offers a simple way to create TV ads—you can enter your URL and create branded ad spots using AI in 30 seconds.


To reach existing audiences across streaming apps and TV channels, use Klaviyo’s[Vibe integration](https://marketplace.klaviyo.com/en-us/apps/01j3kxgbhsnk0j67c8d1zyrzyh/) to target key segments, retarget website visitors, and re-engage email subscribers with CTV ads.


### StackAdapt


[StackAdapt](https://www.stackadapt.com/) is an AI-powered integrated marketing and advertising platform that helps you activate email marketing data for programmatic advertising. This tool incorporates first-party data, intelligent audiences, contextual data, and location-based targeting to help you target hyper-specific segments at scale.


StackAdapt reaches audiences on different devices and across:


- Native ads
- Display ads
- Connected TV ads
- Audio ads
- In-game ads
- Digital out-of-home ads
- Email ads


If you’re using Klaviyo B2C CRM, you can bring your marketing contacts and activities into StackAdapt using Klaviyo’s[StackAdapt integration](https://marketplace.klaviyo.com/en-us/apps/01hz30sk29f3c6v9wfhyjcn02w/) . Then, you can create custom audiences and personalized ads, and run cohesive, cross-channel campaigns from StackAdapt.


### Pinpoint


[Pinpoint](https://info.getpinpoint.io/) helps direct-to-consumer brands turn their audiences into customers with AI marketing teammates that “live on your social media channels.” Here’s how it works:


- Replicate your email and text message marketing flows, like welcome series, into Instagram and TikTok DMs.
- Collect phone numbers and emails inside of social media DMs.
- Send DMs about product drops or offers to your whole audience.


Let’s say your average order value is $25 and you have 100,000 social media followers. Pinpoint estimates that by using their advertising platform, you could generate an additional $25,000 per month.


Pinpoint helps connect social media to your direct marketing channels. Using Klaviyo’s[Pinpoint integration](https://marketplace.klaviyo.com/en-us/apps/01k3p9m88a75d2axpdb6deh6xh/) , you can sync Pinpoint contacts from Instagram and TikTok to Klaviyo B2C CRM, and plug Pinpoint into your existing welcome flow in Klaviyo.


### Blend AI


[Blend AI](https://blend-ai.com/) uses AI to automatically launch and optimize ad campaigns for ecommerce brands. To boost sales, the platform identifies customers and synchronizes data across marketing channels, figuring out the best offer for each contact.


Blend helps you get more from your ad dollars by analyzing performance across channels and taking action on its own, improving budget and creative to improve results. You can build one ad creative, then send it out across Facebook, Instagram, Google, TikTok, and YouTube in seconds.


This platform is ideal if your team is running lots of ads across channels, where you need everything to virtually run on its own while getting better all the time.


Using Klaviyo’s[Blend AI integration](https://marketplace.klaviyo.com/en-us/apps/01hyavr42qwwxsb8h6r24zs1sf/) , you can bring in customer insights from your CRM to:


- Capture cart data.
- Send more emails.
- Create richer content.


### Customers.ai


[Customers.ai](http://customers.ai/) is a pixel on your ecommerce website that helps identify high-value customers and visitors for flows, like people who have abandoned carts, viewed products, or visited high-intent pages.


Customers.ai uses AI models to analyze on-site activities and find patterns, giving you more data about browsing behavior, product interest, and intent, which improves the performance of your flows. It gives you the ability to:


- Capture more customer behavior than you can get with traditional tracking.
- Build audiences by level of purchase intent.
- Connect your messages to your audience to improve visibility and engagement.


Using Klaviyo’s[Customers.ai integration](https://marketplace.klaviyo.com/en-us/apps/01jvqbdgr0rvpg4yjq07tcg45v/) , you can identify high-intent visitors and send the event data to Klaviyo, then understand the revenue you’re driving from these smarter flows.


One health and wellness ecommerce brand[used Customers.ai with Klaviyo](https://customers.ai/case-studies/dtc-health-and-wellness) to learn who visits their site, segment visitors based on which ads they clicked to get there and which product pages they visited, and finally send more relevant abandoned cart automations.


### X for Business


The Kepios analysis shows that X has an audience of over 550 million.[X reports](https://business.x.com/en/advertising) that this audience is 76% more likely to be the first to try new things, and 45% more likely to click on ads.


For ecommerce brands specifically,[X data](https://business.x.com/en/products/shopping) shows that 89% of shoppers they surveyed use X to discover new products, and 76% of people on X surveyed say that conversations on X have led them to buy something.


[X Ads](https://business.x.com/en) span a few different formats, including:


- Vertical Video Ads
- Dynamic Product Ads
- Amplify Pre-rolls
- Amplify Sponsorships
- Timeline Takeovers
- Spotlight Takeovers


With Klaviyo’s[X Audiences integration](https://marketplace.klaviyo.com/en-us/apps/01k1kwm3xjhakxkqcg0yc3dxj6/) , you can deliver more personalized ads and increase ROAS by:


- Syncing lists and segments from Klaviyo to X Custom Audiences
- Retargeting recently engaged audiences who didn’t convert
- Building lookalike audiences to find more of your best customers


## Drive more conversions across digital advertising channels with Klaviyo


Ads aren’t cheap. You need to make sure the dollars you invest in them are bringing in solid returns, and helping you effectively reach your audiences.


By connecting known customers and subscribers with advertising platforms, you can improve targeting, save money by not showing ads to recent purchasers, and create lookalike audiences based on your most valuable customers.


[Klaviyo integrates with popular advertising platforms](https://www.klaviyo.com/features/audience-sync) like Google Ads, Meta for Business, TikTok for Business, and more, empowering you to:


- Simplify audience syncing.
- Build lookalike audiences.
- Boost conversions with smarter targeting.
- Save money by avoiding overlap.
- Find new fans.
